decisions.quote: We successfully replicated Alicke (1985). More than thirty years after the original finding, people still believe they are better than average on desirable traits. The effect of desirability on the better-than-average effect is stronger for traits considered controllable.
decisions.reason: Although the authors note in the discussion that the unhypothesized main effect of controllability did not replicate, both pre-registered replication hypotheses (trait desirability and the desirability-by-controllability interaction) were supported, and the authors state an explicit overall verdict in the conclusion that they successfully replicated Alicke (1985). Under Rule 1 of the codebook, an overall verdict speaking to the replication as a whole decides the outcome.
